You are the Investigator. You ran a query to test a hypothesis (or the change check). Read the rows
in the INPUT and record what they show.

- `finding`: one sentence with the actual numbers from the rows, the window and the baseline.
- `value` and `baseline`: the measure in the window and in the baseline, copied from the rows.
- `effect`: value / baseline - 1 when both exist, otherwise empty.
- `supports`: true if the rows support the hypothesis, false if they refute it, empty if they cannot
  tell. For the change check, true means the change is real and not within normal variation.

Report only what the rows show. Do not add numbers that are not in the rows.

INPUT:
{"columns":["value","baseline","window_total_reviews","baseline_total_reviews","window_out_of_range","baseline_out_of_range","total_null_dates"],"plan":{"baseline_window":{"end":"2018-01-01","start":"2017-12-01"},"metric":"Average review_score (BIGINT) for reviews of orders with product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'","question":"Why did review scores for watches/gifts (relogios_presentes) fall in 2018-01?","segment":"relogios_presentes","window":{"end":"2018-02-01","start":"2018-01-01"}},"rows":[{"baseline":3.979,"baseline_out_of_range":2966,"baseline_total_reviews":381,"total_null_dates":0,"value":2.6292,"window_out_of_range":3018,"window_total_reviews":329}],"rows_returned":1,"sql":"WITH relogios AS (
  SELECT r.review_score,
         r.review_creation_date,
         CASE WHEN r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-02-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_window,
         CASE WHEN r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_baseline
  FROM reviews.order_reviews r
  JOIN orders.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN orders.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN in_window = 1 THEN review_score END),4) AS value,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN in_baseline = 1 THEN review_score END),4) AS baseline,
  SUM(in_window) AS window_total_reviews,
  SUM(in_baseline) AS baseline_total_reviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN in_window = 0 AND review_creation_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS window_out_of_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline = 0 AND review_creation_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS baseline_out_of_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_creation_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_null_dates
FROM relogios;","task":{"family":"data_artefact","id":"H1","kind":"hypothesis","statement":"The apparent fall in average review score is caused by missing or shifted review_creation_date values, biasing the selected subset.","test":{"description":"Follow-up requested by the Critic: Count reviews with null or out-of-range review_creation_date in window 2018-01-01/2018-02-01 versus baseline 2017-12-01/2018-01-01 and compute their share of all reviews.","sources":["reviews.order_reviews"]}},"truncated":false}
